posts.name: jorgenp
posts.cooked:
Mint.

Man, Baron Blade got a godly reshuffle on his flip in my game.  He got early Hasten Doom and "Consider the Price of Victory!" plays in, meaning he was about to start hitting me for 8 damage per turn.  My recently technologically inferior heroes wouldn't have lasted long, but thankfully, neither did the Baron.

posts.cooked:
Arcanist Lupus:

Mint.  I got lucky enough to Hypersonic Assault the Baron on the turn before he played Devious Disruption.  Without his nuke he went down easy.

Same. Having each hero always pick the most-damaging play* tends to make Mad Bomber go down quickly; dodging the Disruption was just icing on the cake. Won during the start phase of AZ's 5th turn with all heroes' HP in the mid-to-high teens.

*Except in one case where skipping Tachyon's last play led to the T-Rex biting Blade for 6.

posts.name: Reverend Pete
posts.cooked:
Mint.

 

I Hypersonic-ed before the Disruption, too. It was a matter of playing Nimble Strikes to draw it, and Lightning Reflexes to play it. Or something like that.

 

Stun Bolt was nice--sure kept the damage down.

 

Most heroes around 20 HP, Absolute Zero was closer to 10 because of Frost-Bound Drain self-damage.
